title: Sparse Dictionary Learning for Measure-Valued Data via Linearized Optimal Transport: Efficient Algorithms and Sample Complexity
abstract: arXiv:2610.12924v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study dictionary learning for probability measure-valued data by embedding measures into Hilbert spaces using features derived from optimal transport geometry. We learn data-adapted dictionaries through sparse autoencoder parameterizations, producing fast, scalable representations of probability measures as sparse finite-dimensional codes. The resulting framework combines the rich, geometric structure of optimal transport with the interpretability and efficiency of sparse representation learning. We demonstrate its utility across diverse data modalities, including hyperspectral images, geometric point clouds, and document embeddings in large language model latent spaces. We also prove generalization bounds for sparse dictionary learning objectives on broad classes of $L^2$-valued measure embeddings, expressed in terms of the metric complexity of the atom class. translated_title: 基于线性化最优传输的测度值数据稀疏字典学习：高效算法与样本复杂度
translated_abstract: 我们通过使用源自最优传输几何的特征将概率测度嵌入到希尔伯特空间中，研究概率测度值数据的字典学习问题。我们通过稀疏自编码器参数化学习数据自适应的字典，将概率测度表示为快速、可扩展的稀疏有限维编码。所得框架将最优传输丰富的几何结构与稀疏表示学习的可解释性和高效性相结合。我们在多种数据模态上展示了该框架的实用性，包括高光谱图像、几何点云以及大语言模型潜在空间中的文档嵌入。我们还针对广泛的 $L^2$ 值测度嵌入类别，证明了稀疏字典学习目标的泛化界，该泛化界以原子类的度量复杂度来表示。对于最优传输和熵正则化传输映射字典，我们推导了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一个基于线性化最优传输的稀疏字典学习框架，将概率测度嵌入希尔伯特空间并通过稀疏自编码器学习数据自适应字典，实现对高光谱图像、点云及大语言模型文档嵌入等测度值数据的高效可解释表示，同时给出以原子类度量复杂度刻画的泛化界和样本复杂度理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a sparse dictionary learning framework for probability measure-valued data based on linearized optimal transport, embedding measures into Hilbert spaces and learning data-adapted dictionaries via sparse autoencoders, enabling efficient and interpretable representations across modalities such as hyperspectral images, point clouds, and LLM document embeddings, with generalization bounds and sample complexity guarantees expressed through the metric complexity of the atom class.
